reasoning: The document proposes an entirely different causal story (a schema index change slowing enqueue writes) than the supplied facts (unbounded 1s retries saturating all 64 worker slots). It invents evidence not in the reference facts (schema-114, 812,400 queue depth, db CPU at 86%, billing-api v6.1.2, EXPLAIN gate), never identifies the retry amplification mechanism, and treats database CPU as causal. It gets a few facts right (v2.8.1 log-only, gateway 503 timing noted as coincidental, 07:01 drain) but overall contradicts the reference facts.
